memories_help_tip_variant.description: Allowed values: save, music, none. A/B-test save versus music; optimize save_completed. none is a no-tip control.

memories_help_tips_enabled.description: Disable contextual tips remotely. Local analytics opt-out always overrides this.

memories_review_requests_enabled.description: Disable automatic StoreKit review requests. Local eligibility and cooldown cannot be overridden.
